text: This report recommends that the name "George Duncan Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane north of Kingston Road, extending easterly from Lawlor Avenue. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "George Duncan Lane" for an existing public lane north of Kingston Road, extending easterly from Lawlor Avenue.
